The scheduled headlining performers were Sabrina Carpenter, Justin Bieber, Karol G, and Anyma. It sold out within a week of its announcement.

The 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival lineup has been unveiled. Sabrina Carpenter, Justin Bieber, and Karol G are heading to the desert next year as the festival’s headliners, topping the two-weekend bill in Indio, California, on April 10-12 and 17-19. Also slated to perform are Young Thug, the xx, Turnstile, David Byrne, FKA twigs, Addison Rae, Ethel Cain, and dozens more. See the full lineup and festival poster below.

## Parking & Directions

Expand All Sections Close All Sections

PARKING INFO & TIPS FOR EVERYONE

- Arrive early to avoid delays.
- Park where instructed by parking personnel.
- ATTENDEES WILL BE DIRECTED IN REAL TIME AS TRAFFIC CONDITIONS MAY FLUCTUATE.
- Remember where you park by taking a pic of the lot number sign or drop a pin!
- Pay attention to the color path you use to walk from parking to venue.
- No tailgating allowed.
- No camping or sleeping in your car.
- No RV, trailer or golf cart parking.
- Separate, Accessible Parking lot available (See Accessibility / ADA)
- Parking & Directions maps will be posted closer to festival dates.

Address / Getting Here

Empire Polo Club 81-800 Avenue 51 Indio, CA 92201

- Follow directions below and on festival maps (posted closer to festival dates).
- Follow signs and obey all traffic laws & personnel.
- Not following instructions may send you driving in circles due to road closures, no left turns, etc.
- Traffic routes are subject to change.

DAY PARKING INFO & DIRECTIONS

Hours Friday-Sunday 11am-2am

Info

- Day parking is not guaranteed, as per capacity restrictions.
- Cars left after 2am will be towed.
- Everyone in the vehicle must be wearing a Festival Wristband.
- No pick-ups or drop-offs in Day Parking (use Pick Up & Drop Off location).
- Motorcycles may park in ADA lot.

Directions

- From All Directions, approach Empire Polo Club.
- Follow signs and traffic personnel.

PRO-TIP: fill your car with 4+ friends and decorate it for CARPOOLCHELLA ® - and you could win prizes like VIP for life. Learn More

Preferred Parking Info

Hours Friday-Sunday 11am-2am

Info

- Access the Preferred Parking Lot via Ave 49/Monroe St. Do not use Hjorth St.
- Park and enter the Venue through the north entrance.
- No vehicle ins & outs.
- No pick-ups or drop-offs (use Pick Up & Drop Off location).
- Vehicles parked must fit within the 8.5’ x 16’ spot.
- Purchase of a preferred parking pass is required (valid Fri-Sun).
- No entry allowed after 10pm.
- Cars left after 2am will be towed.
- Everyone in the vehicle must be wearing a Festival Wristband.
- Visit passes page to purchase.

Directions From 10 Eastbound:

- Exit at Monroe St. and travel south.
- Right at Ave 49.
- Left into Lot 1 on left.

⚠ Don’t attempt to approach north on Monroe.

## Camping Parking & Directions

Expand All Sections Close All Sections

COMPANION CAMPING PARKING & READY-SET TENT PARKING (LOT 2A)

Hours: Thursday 9am - Monday 9am

Companion Camping Parking Info:

- One (1) overnight parking space for an additional vehicle of campers.
- This is not a camping spot.
- Parking space valid Thu-Mon. Limit one (1) per order.
- A very limited amount of Camping Companion Parking Passes are available. If you don’t get one, you’ll have to transport your whole crew and their camping gear in one vehicle.
- Located adjacent to the campgrounds, but may not be near your campsite.
- All vehicles will be thoroughly searched.
- Everyone in the vehicle must be wearing Festival Wristband.
- No camping or sleeping in your car.
- Check-in Thu 9am-2am; Fri-Sun 9am-8pm.
- No ins/outs. No exit during lockdown hours Fri-Sun 9pm-2am.
- If you need to leave Camping Companion Parking prior to 2am on any night, you must do so before 9pm.
- All hours are subject to change based on safety concerns and traffic conditions.
- If you drive out, you will forfeit your spot.

PRO-TIP: Pack your heavy supplies in the vehicle that will be parked in your Car Camping site. Save your strength on the walk from Car Companion Camping.

Companion Camping Parking & Ready-Set Tent Parking Directions:

- From 10 Eastbound
- Exit at Jefferson St., continue to Indio Blvd.
- Right at Jefferson St.
- Left at Ave 50.
- Left at Madison and immediate right into Lot 2A.

ⓘ All friend & family pick up & drop off, rideshare and taxi drop-offs are here on Thursday.

PREMIUM CAMPING PARKING (LA CAMPANA / LAKE ELDORADO) (LOT 4A)

Hours:Thu 9am–Mon 9am.

Directions:

- From 10 Eastbound
- Exit at Jefferson St., continue to Indio Blvd.
- Right at Jefferson St.
- Left at Ave 50.
- Right at Madison St.
- Follow signs to Premium Camping Parking: Lake Eldorado / La Campana on left.

CAR CAMPING / GROUP CAR CAMPING / POWERED CAR CAMPING / PREFERRED & PREFERRED FRONT ROW CAR CAMPING / TOLLBOOTHS (LOT 13A OR 2A* Thursday only)

Hours: Thursday 9am – Monday 9am

Directions:

Car campers will be directed in real time to either the North or *South tollbooths

- *Thursday only, until 3pm.

*Subject to change, check back closer to festival dates for most updated info.

Shuttles

Coachella Shuttle Hop on board for a safe, comfortable and environmentally-conscious alternative for show day transportation all weekend long.

LAX Shuttle Pass Traveling far and wide this year? Let Valley Music Travel take the wheel with convenient pick-up on Thursday or Friday and drop-off at LAX on Monday.

Rideshare

Hours: Friday–Sunday:11am–3am

Location: Ave. 49 and Monroe St. in Lot 1D

Directions:

- No Thursday drop-offs. Must use Lot 2A.
- Follow the Yellow Path to and from the festival.
- Shade and phone charging is available while you wait for your ride.
- Expect the highest wait times between 12am–2:30am each night.
- Check all product types for the shortest ETA.

Pick Up & Drop Off

Thursday Hours & Location: 9am – 2am Lot 2A Camping Companion Parking

Thursday Directions:

- From 10 Eastbound
- Exit at Jefferson St. continue to Indio Blvd.
- Right at Jefferson St.
- Left at Ave 50.
- Follow signs to LOT 2A on left.

Friday–Sunday Hours & Location: Car Camping/Toll Booths (lot 13) at Ave. 52 and Madison (enter off Madison)

Friday–Sunday Directions:

- From 10 Eastbound
- Exit at Jefferson St. continue to Indio Blvd.
- Right at Jefferson St.
- Follow signs and traffic personnel to check-in lanes.
- Enter via Madison.

⚠️ Absolutely no pedestrians will be allowed on Monroe (between Ave 49 and Ave 52) or Madison (between Ave 50 and Ave 52).

*subject to change
